name: hide-diffs
description: Shows a one-line summary instead of the diff under Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Bash calls; ctrl+q toggles it

smallDiffLines.title: Show small diffs
smallDiffLines.description: Diffs with this many changed lines or fewer are shown in full. 0 hides every diff.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Shown at the start of each hidden diff, so it is easy to spot. Leave empty for none.
